long_biography.plain_text:
Pokolenie began in 1996 as Andrei Skoch's initiative to help children with congenital heart conditions. The Russian industrial investor developed it from the original Healthy Generation programme into a broader foundation supporting medical treatment and regional health infrastructure. Its work has included medical equipment and a centre intended to bring specialist care to families outside Moscow.

Skoch also used the foundation to support cultural work. It created the Debut prize for young Russian-language writers, with categories spanning prose, poetry, drama and essays. The independent award combined publication with international promotion, giving emerging writers a wider platform for their early work.
long_biography.html:
Pokolenie began in 1996 as Andrei Skoch's initiative to help children with congenital heart conditions. The Russian industrial investor developed it from the original Healthy Generation programme into a broader foundation supporting medical treatment and regional health infrastructure. Its work has included medical equipment and a centre intended to bring specialist care to families outside Moscow.

Skoch also used the foundation to support cultural work. It created the Debut prize for young Russian-language writers, with categories spanning prose, poetry, drama and essays. The independent award combined publication with international promotion, giving emerging writers a wider platform for their early work.
